description: This file defines the BankTransfer controller class within the Opencart e-commerce framework. It handles displaying bank transfer payment instructions and confirming the payment, managing order status updates and redirecting the user after payment confirmation.

classes.name: BankTransfer
classes.description: Controller class for handling bank transfer payments within the OpenCart platform.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads language, prepares data for the bank transfer view, and returns the rendered view.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Processes payment confirmation, updates order status, and redirects accordingly, handling errors and session validation.
